brief: Inspect the cooling control in manual or unproven and the active seepage at the lower gasket face, with staining visible on the plinth [MG-021, MG-023, MG-025]. Treat the cooling control in manual or unproven as one stage unavailable and reduce permissible load in proportion to the cooling capacity lost, in addition to ambient de-rating [MG-021]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
